title: Language-Guided Tuning: Configuration Optimization for Automated ML Research
abstract: arXiv:2508.15757v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Configuration optimization remains a critical bottleneck in machine learning, requiring coordinated tuning across model architecture, training strategy, feature engineering, and hyperparameters. Traditional approaches treat these dimensions independently and lack interpretability, while recent automated methods struggle with dynamic adaptability and semantic reasoning about optimization decisions. We introduce Language-Guided Tuning (LGT), a framework that employs multi-agent Large Language Models to automatically optimize configurations through natural language reasoning. We apply textual feedback signals that complement numerical optimization by providing semantic understanding of training dynamics and configuration interdependencies. translated_title: 语言引导调优：面向自动化机器学习研究的配置优化
translated_abstract: 配置优化仍然是机器学习中的一个关键瓶颈，需要在模型架构、训练策略、特征工程和超参数等多个维度上进行协调调优。传统方法将这些维度独立处理且缺乏可解释性，而近期的自动化方法则在动态适应性和对优化决策的语义推理方面存在不足。我们提出了语言引导调优（LGT），这是一个利用多智能体大语言模型通过自然语言推理自动优化配置的框架。我们应用文本反馈信号来补充数值优化，通过提供对训练动态和配置间相互依赖关系的语义理解来增强优化效果。LGT协调三个专门的智能体：负责提出配置变更的顾问、负责评估进展的评估器，以及负责完善决策过程的优化器，从而构建一个自（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了LGT框架，利用多智能体大语言模型通过自然语言推理和文本反馈信号，自动协调优化机器学习中模型架构、训练策略、特征工程和超参数等多维配置，解决了传统方法缺乏可解释性和语义推理能力的瓶颈。
en_tdlr: Proposes LGT, a multi-agent LLM framework that automatically optimizes ML configurations across architecture, training strategy, feature engineering, and hyperparameters through natural language reasoning and textual feedback signals, addressing the interpretability and semantic reasoning limitations of traditional approaches.
